fact: Phase3 and Sonatel activated a 3,500km terrestrial fibre route from Lagos, Nigeria, to Dakar, Senegal, through Benin, Togo and Ghana; commercial availability and service packages were still to be announced.

APS reports that Senegal's SENUM SA and Mali's SMTD-SA inaugurated the interconnection of their national fibre-optic backbones at the Kidira-Diboli border bridge on Monday 2026-10-05, described by SENUM's director general as putting the infrastructure into service; no capacity or traffic figure is given.
system: interconnexion des backbones du Senegal et du Mali (SENUM SA - SMTD-SA)
